authorization: Active Phase1 feature-training goal; pre-existing third-priority RDrop source route; new E20/LS0/cleanL diagnostic after specified E50 seed02/03 parents found absent; no training/query expansion

code.environment: ordinary N607 CVS-RFFI Python; CPU2, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; immutable original R02 code dependency

data.representation: Existing raw post_sync/noeq clean IQ,256 samples; no explicit CFO identity coordinate; original internal compensation retained

roles.L_s: 6300 existing role; fixed900 unique physical packets forwarded per executed parent
roles.V: 27000 existing source cache returned once then discarded; no forward/gradient

data.capsule_id: existing VALIDATED_ONCE Phase1 capsule manifest; reuse unchanged
data.split_id: original registered source/target physical split; reuse unchanged
data.source_days_correction: Descriptive metadata corrected from [0,1,2] to actual native wisig_train_days/day_i [1,2,3]; same exact physical role IDs, no data or run change

permissions.claim_scope: Frozen source default-head gradient compatibility only; no training gain,DG,newTX,Phase2,satellite or84 claim

checkpoint.initialization: Read-only frozen original BASE_SSL final20 parents; no new training or EMA model
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original R02 provenance.source_proof before each torch.load; validate_checkpoint and strict full model state load
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Original source metadata independently verified in completed matched study; all source/ancestry/actual_args/fixed-final checks repeated before each diagnostic load
checkpoint.selection_rule: All three original BASE_SSL final20 students fixed by source plan, independent of target scores; NONE/CLEAN_SIG parents never substituted

execution.gpu_policy: CPU2 only; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty;0 GPU process allocation; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: First seed source-qualification FAIL stops before other parents; if PASS run both remaining fixed parents. Any provenance/query/role mismatch, nonfinite, state mutation, wrong cohort, recount error or output conflict aborts owned pipeline and preserves artifacts. No retry, coefficient/layer/parent scan, or other process intervention.

metric_names: aggregate CE/KL cosine and norm ratio
metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Saved source logits only; no target predictions
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: Fresh CPU saved-artifact recount; no new forwards/gradients or truth connections

notes: New diagnostic, not a renamed replication: E20 vs E50; LS0 vsLS.01; cleanL vs strong GaussianL; single SIG projection versus prior multiview views.0 projection.
Parent training cost already3x20/4440; no trained weights are altered. A reused frozen parent is not a scratch training model and source accuracy is not a new DG result.
900 distinct L physical packets shared across executed parents, not2700 independent physical samples or15 independent gradient seeds; source cohorts are repeated matched measurements.
Only two losses compared as gradients; defaultW is observed, never fitted or updated. Eval reference uses the same clean input with native dropout inactive.
All3 required for source confirmation; no automatic new training release. Passing may support a separately fixed genuine heldRX matched twoCE/RDrop falsification.

Existing original BASE_SSL parents are fixed before this diagnostic; completed NONE small positive and CLEAN_SIG negative incremental evidence are preserved, never used to switch parents or coefficients.
RDrop is established, https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2021/hash/5a66b9200f29ac3fa0ae244cc2a51b39-Abstract.html ; this is a CVS source learning-signal test, not a global novelty claim.
